# Tier 1 Veterinary Medical Center

> > Tier 1 Veterinary Medical Center is a Palmer, Alaska-based veterinary practice specializing in preventive care, surgical procedures like gastropexy for GDV prevention, and pet safety education for active outdoor lifestyles.

Tier 1 VMC serves pet owners in Alaska with expertise in cold-weather breeds, working dogs, and outdoor-active pets. The practice emphasizes preventive medicine, surgical interventions, and educational resources for both pet owners and veterinary professionals.

## Key Topics

- Gastropexy surgery and GDV prevention
- Microchipping and pet identification
- Pet safety and toxicity prevention
- Multi-pet household integration
- Cold-weather breed care
- Giardia in water dogs
- Pet hydration management
- Fall and winter pet safety
- Veterinary education programs
- Arctic breed nutrition
- Outdoor activity safety for pets
- Canine bloat prevention
- Lost pet recovery strategies

## Surgical Services & Preventive Procedures

- [Gastropexy Surgery: What's the Big Flipping Deal?](https://tier1vet.com/gastropexy): Gastropexy surgery for GDV prevention in deep-chested dog breeds

## Pet Safety & Health

- [What Are the Benefits of Microchipping Pets?](https://tier1vet.com/what-are-the-benefits-of-microchipping-pets): Explains microchipping benefits for pet identification and lost pet recovery
- [Are Fall Foods Toxic to Pets?](https://tier1vet.com/are-fall-foods-toxic-to-pets): Fall food toxicity guide for pet safety during Halloween season
- [What Every Pet Owner Should Know About Pet Hydration](https://tier1vet.com/what-every-pet-owner-should-know-about-pet-hydration): Essential pet hydration and water intake guide for dog and cat owners
- [Giardia: The Bane of Water Dogs](https://tier1vet.com/giardia): Giardia parasite info for hunting and water dogs with prevention tips

## Pet Behavior & Multi-Pet Households

- [Introducing Cats and Dogs In Your Home](https://tier1vet.com/introducing-cats-and-dogs): Guide to introducing cats and dogs for peaceful multi-pet household

## Seasonal & Outdoor Pet Care

- [Fall Hiking Safety Tips for Pet Owners](https://tier1vet.com/fall-hiking-safety-tips-for-pet-owners): Fall hiking safety tips and outdoor activity prep for dog owners
- [Are there specific breeds that need more food in the winter?](https://tier1vet.com/are-there-specific-breeds-that-need-more-food-in-the-winter): Winter feeding guide for arctic breeds and cold-weather working dogs

## Professional Education & Training

- [Education Opportunities](https://tier1vet.com/education): Educational courses for students, pet owners, and DVMs at Palmer facility
